class.name: CgameCrowdAvoidance
class.brief_description: Native ORCA (Optimal Reciprocal Collision Avoidance) velocity solver for large 2D crowds.
class.description: Computes collision-free velocities for many agents at once using the ORCA algorithm from the RVO2 Library (van den Berg, Guy, Snape, Lin and Manocha; Apache-2.0, see [code]LICENSE-RVO2.txt[/code] in the module folder). Neighbours are found with a uniform spatial hash (average O(n)) instead of a k-d tree, each agent solves its half-plane constraints with a 2D linear program, and a 3D linear program minimises the maximum violation when no feasible velocity exists. The work is spread over the [WorkerThreadPool] once there are at least 256 agents. Every agent reads only the immutable input arrays, so the result is bit-identical for any thread count and for repeated calls with the same input. Neighbours at equal distance are ordered by index. This class has no instance state; call [method compute_velocities] directly on the class. It is the native counterpart of [code]scripts/shared/crowd_avoidance.gd[/code] and has the same signature. [codeblock] var new_velocities = CgameCrowdAvoidance.compute_velocities( positions, velocities, preferred, 0.5, 1.5, 3.0, 10.0, 16, delta) [/codeblock]

method.name: compute_velocities
method.description: Returns new velocities, in the same order as the input, that avoid collisions with other agents within [param time_horizon] seconds. All three input arrays must have the same size; otherwise an error is printed and a zero-filled array is returned. An empty input returns an empty array. [param radius] is the radius of every agent (two agents touch at [code]2 * radius[/code]). [param max_speed] bounds the result length and also clamps [param preferred]. [param neighbor_dist] is the search distance and [param max_neighbors] caps how many of the nearest agents are considered. [param time_step] is the simulation step used to resolve agents that already overlap.
